title: 환경정책기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Standards and Methods for Establishing City, County, and District Environmental Plans)
(1) Environmental plans for cities, counties, and districts (referring to districts of self-governing areas, hereinafter referred to as "city, county, and district environmental plans") in accordance with Article 19(1) of this Act must be consistent with the National Environmental Comprehensive Plan and the Provincial Environmental Plan.
(2) The Mayor, County Executive, or District Mayor (referring to the District Mayor of a self-governing area) must prepare the city, county, and district environmental plan, including the following matters:
1. Analysis of the current situation and management/preservation plans related to the following items:
    a. Natural and ecological environments, including ecosystems and biodiversity
    b. Living and climate environments, including air, water, soil, and climate
2. Organization and budget for the implementation of the city, county, and district environmental plan.
(3) In addition to the matters stipulated in (1) and (2), the Minister of Climate and Energy will determine the necessary matters for the standards and methods for establishing and preparing city, county, and district environmental plans. <Amended as of 2025.10.1>
